automated_findings.description: A form field has no programmatic label (label/for, aria-label or title). Placeholder text alone is not a label.
Images without an alt attribute are announced as file names or skipped by screen readers.
A button has no accessible name.
A link has no discernible text.
An element reacts to mouse clicks but cannot be reached or activated by keyboard.
Pinch-zoom is blocked, which prevents low-vision users from enlarging text on phones.
The page does not declare its language, so screen readers may pronounce it with the wrong voice.
The page has no main (h1) heading.
tabindex values above 0 override the natural keyboard order and usually cause confusing navigation.
A frame has no title describing its content.
A data table has no header cells (th), so screen readers cannot associate cells with headers.
Heading levels skip (for example h2 followed by h4), which confuses document outlines.
Link text like “click here” or “read more” is meaningless out of context (screen readers list links on their own).
No “skip to main content” link was found near the top (best practice for keyboard users).

manual_review_items.why_manual: A tool cannot tell whether an image carries information.
manual_review_items.how_to_test: Review each image with alt=""; add real alt text if it conveys meaning (e.g. charts, scanned notices).

manual_review_items.check: Mark language changes inside the page
manual_review_items.why_manual: Mixed-script text was detected but a tool cannot tell which passages need lang attributes.
manual_review_items.how_to_test: Check that passages in Kannada, Latin are wrapped with the matching lang attribute.

manual_review_items.why_manual: Needs rendered colours/backgrounds and images; not reliably derivable from markup.
manual_review_items.how_to_test: Run a contrast checker on text, buttons and focus indicators (4.5:1 for body text).

manual_review_items.why_manual: Announcement order and clarity can only be judged by listening.
manual_review_items.how_to_test: Test key tasks with NVDA (Windows), VoiceOver or TalkBack, with the screen off.

manual_review_items.why_manual: Dynamic behaviour (menus, dialogs, focus traps) is not visible in static HTML.
manual_review_items.how_to_test: Complete the main task using Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter and Esc only.

manual_review_items.why_manual: Presence of captions can't be verified from static markup.
manual_review_items.how_to_test: Check that videos have captions and audio has transcripts.

manual_review_items.check: Quality of alt text and link text
manual_review_items.why_manual: Tools detect missing text, not whether it is meaningful.
manual_review_items.how_to_test: Read alt texts and link texts aloud out of context.
